images.scene: The FINAL MOMENT of Universe 647 AFTER its fields, house, soil, furniture and other mass have been returned. A SINGLE TRANSPARENT SPHERICAL ECOHABITAT about HALF A METRE in diameter FLOATS WEIGHTLESS IN COMPLETE EMPTY DARKNESS. Inside it are SEVERAL SEPARATE FLOATING SPHERICAL WATER GLOBULES, some holding tiny fish and some green algae, plus TWO SMALL FLOATING PIECES OF LAND topped with delicate green grass. They float independently in zero gravity: absolutely no horizontal aquarium waterline, no fishbowl base and no aquarium sediment covering a flat bottom. A very small LIGHT SOURCE fixed at the sphere's TOP shines as its miniature sun and illuminates the tiny ecosystem with soft natural light. Farther away and almost invisible in blackness is a small plain METAL RECTANGULAR INFORMATION CONTAINER, not a glass bottle; it is secondary, just a faint edge reflection. No house, wheat field, table, planet, starfield, nebula, giant external sun or extra glowing spheres. The sphere is moderately prominent within the panorama so the water globules and two grassy islets are readable, surrounded by overwhelming black empty space. Tender and unresolved survival, no text.
